messages:
rachel: FYI tenants hitting OIDC token exchange 401s after last JWKS prune. Affected flow: client_assertion -> /oauth/token. Saw a sudden spike at 10:12 PDT. @sec-sre :eyes:

tom: grabbing logs for oidc-proxy. saw "kid not found" in token_verifier. Maybe some clients still signing with rotated kid.

priya: interesting — we also shipped an RBAC change earlier that strips the "team-" prefix from group claims in the SAML->OIDC mapping (PR #901). Could be group-to-role mapping mismatch causing automatic deprovisioning.

rachel: log excerpt:
```
2025-02-13T17:12:23Z oidc-proxy ERROR token_validation failed kid=KID-73 err="public key not found"
2025-02-13T17:12:23Z scim-provisioner INFO reconcile user=svc-user-7 group_claims=["ops","team-backend"] -> mapped_roles=[] action=deprov
```

tom: aha — scim mapper expected groups that begin with "team-" and would map to svc roles. Without a match you get empty roles which triggers our deprov policy.

priya: do we have an audit timeline showing when the JWKS prune ran vs the RBAC mapping rollout? Need ordering to understand blast radius.

rachel: timeline i pulled: RBAC change rolled 2025-02-13T16:45:00Z, JWKS prune cron ran 2025-02-13T17:10:00Z. Some clients kept sending tokens signed with the old KID until ~17:20.

tom: suggested mitigations:
1) re-add a temporary compatibility mapping in scim_mappers to accept group names with and without "team-" prefix for 48h.
2) re-publish the old JWKS entry into keystore with limited TTL so token validation accepts old KIDs.
3) run targeted reprovision for impacted tenants to reconcile roles.

priya: agree. Security note: republishing old JWKS entry increases trust window for historical keys — restrict scope/TTL, add extra logging, and make a change advisory.

idp-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-0091 severity=medium owner=tom mitigation_window=3h link=https://console.redwood/inc/INC-2025-0091

rachel: deploying mapper fallback to canary now. will monitor audit log for auto-deprov spikes and token_401_rate.

tom: canary results: token_401_rate dropped from 4.8% -> 0.6% after fallback deployed. preparing full cluster rollout. also prepping a short post-incident note for compliance.

priya: filed security ticket SEC-2025-72 to document JWKS reuse decision, affected tenants, and TTL used. i'll include repro steps.

rachel: thanks all. after full deploy i'll run a short postmortem and recommend safer rollout practices: staged JWKS prune + feature flag for RBAC claim-shape changes, and a pre-rollout compatibility check. :seedling:
